column1: # rank.exe determinism -- one row per (subject, colour)
# distinct = distinct move sequences over the replicas (1 = reproducible)
# first_div_ply = first half-move where two replicas differ (-1 = none)
# det = rankAgentIsDeterministic (0 = draws from rand(), expected to fail)
# traceset = hash over the SORTED DISTINCT per-ply position traces. Two runs of
#   this command agree on a row's trajectories exactly when its traceset matches,
#   so diffing two TSVs is an exact cross-process test, not a plies/nodes proxy.
